description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a responsive map component within a web page. It outputs HTML markup with embedded PHP code to dynamically set map properties such as size, tile layer, zoom level, and center coordinates based on a map object.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: A class representing map properties such as size, tile layer, zoom, and center point, used to provide data to the template.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the map in pixels.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the map in pixels.

methods.name: getTileLayer
methods.description: Returns the tile layer URL or identifier used for the map tiles.

methods.name: getZoom
methods.description: Returns the zoom level for the map display.

methods.name: getCenter
methods.description: Returns the geographic coordinate object representing the center of the map.
